purpose: Reference hardware profile for DashCore AutoTest calibration. This profile records the target device and defines safe emulator-side approximations; it does not claim to emulate the Kirin SoC or Mali GPU.

gpu.name: ARM Mali-G51 MP4
gpu.notes: GPU identity is reference metadata only. Android emulator rendering uses the host/virtual GPU and is not a Mali-G51 performance simulation.

memory.note: Guest RAM capacity is approximated; available RAM, memory bandwidth, compression and Android process pressure will differ from the phone.

display.density_note: Unknown; capture from the physical device before setting emulator density.

notes: Do not label cloud-emulator results as physical Huawei Y9s FPS.
Keep the existing AutoTest screenshot/tap coordinate system unchanged until the test workflow is explicitly migrated to a new display profile.
A valid ON/OFF pair must use the same emulator image, level, route, attempt stimulus and sampling window.
Physical-device logs remain the authority for Kirin CPU scheduling, Mali-G51 rendering, thermal throttling and real frame pacing.
